product_one_liner: Content recommendation for the new social web
product_description_excerpt: Bluesky is a Twitter alternative that provides an open marketplace of feeds and lets users choose which ones they want to use. Skygaze makes a feed for Bluesky—it's like if the Twitter feed was a separate product. Skygaze's feed is the most popular choice and is a default for all new Bluesky users.
